Dehydrated Thyme Leaves Supplier: Dehydrated Thyme Leaves for Food Manufacturers and Export Buyers

Thyme turns up in stuffing mixes, poultry rubs, soups and herb blends, and buyers need it clean, aromatic and evenly cut. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated thyme leaves supplier in India for food manufacturers, distributors, restaurants, importers and private label brands, with leaf cut to 8-16 mesh. Our product supports seasoning, bakery, ready-to-cook, sauce, soup, and snack applications. We also offer export packaging, an MOQ of 5 Kg, and OEM or private label packing. As a dehydrated thyme leaves exporter, we focus on consistent quality, practical service and planned supply. Buyers can request a sample, product specification, packaging proposal, and dehydrated thyme leaves price quotation from our sales team. We review each inquiry according to volume, destination, packaging, and quality requirements.

Product Overview

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We clean and dry the leaves to reduce moisture while retaining their characteristic herbal aroma and flavor. The finished product provides a convenient alternative to fresh thyme. It offers easier storage, longer usability, and stable performance in commercial recipes. The leaves have a green to greyish-green appearance. They deliver a warm, earthy, slightly minty, and mildly peppery flavor. Therefore, they work well in recipes that need herbal depth without adding liquid. The product contains no intentionally added color, flavor, or preservative unless a buyer requests a customized formulation.

Manufacturing and Processing

Our process begins with raw material selection and incoming inspection. We check the herbs for visible quality, cleanliness, aroma, and general condition. Next, we remove unwanted plant matter and foreign materials through cleaning and sorting. We then use controlled dehydration to lower moisture and protect the product's sensory character. After drying, we inspect the leaves and process them through suitable sieving equipment. This step helps achieve the requested cut or mesh profile. Finally, we pack the product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging.
  • Raw material selection from trusted growers
  • Cleaning, sorting, and foreign material removal
  • Controlled dehydration for moisture reduction
  • Sieving and size grading according to buyer needs
  • Batch inspection, packing, and traceability documentation
We can also discuss custom cutting, private label packing, and bulk supply programs. However, final specifications depend on the agreed product grade and intended application.

Typical Technical Specifications

Our standard dehydrated thyme leaves specification suits many food manufacturing applications. The following values appear on our product specification sheet.
  • Mesh or cut size: 8-16 mesh leaf cut
  • Moisture: ≤ 8%
  • Processing: dehydrated, cleaned and sieved
  • Appearance: clean green to greyish-green dried leaves
  • Flavor: characteristic thyme aroma with earthy, minty, and mildly peppery notes
  • Additives: no intentionally added additives in the standard product
  • Packaging: food-grade, moisture-resistant, and export-suitable formats
A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Where your market requires analytical results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We also provide export documentation support for each shipment.

Applications

Dehydrated thyme leaves add herbal flavor to many food products. They also help manufacturers standardize recipes throughout the year. Because the product has reduced moisture, it integrates easily into dry blends and prepared foods.
  • Seasoning blends for meat, poultry, seafood, and vegetables
  • Soups, sauces, gravies, marinades, and bouillons
  • Pizza, pasta, bakery, and savory snack formulations
  • Ready-to-cook meals and ready-to-eat food products
  • Herbal infusions, stuffing mixes, and culinary herb blends
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering, and cloud kitchen recipes
For example, seasoning manufacturers can combine thyme with oregano, basil, rosemary, garlic, onion, and black pepper. Meanwhile, foodservice buyers can use the leaves in roasted vegetables, meat rubs, sauces, and baked products. We can discuss the desired cut size and flavor intensity for each application.

Buyer Benefits

  • Longer storage life than fresh herbs when stored correctly
  • Lower handling and preparation costs for commercial kitchens
  • Consistent flavor support across multiple production batches
  • Efficient use in dry seasoning and ready-to-cook formulations
  • Flexible pack sizes for distributors, manufacturers, and foodservice buyers
  • Export support with traceable batch and packaging information
Bulk dehydrated thyme leaves can help reduce frequent purchasing and preparation work. In addition, the dry format lowers dependency on fresh herb availability. This can support better inventory planning for manufacturers and hospitality businesses.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Storage

We pack the product in moisture-resistant, food-grade materials. Standard options include pouches, jars, containers, and bulk export packs. Custom printed and private label packaging can also be evaluated for suitable order volumes.
  • Inner food-grade liner with outer woven or kraft bag
  • Stand-up pouches for retail and small wholesale orders
  • PET jars or HDPE containers for branded distribution
  • 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg bulk packs for industrial buyers
  • Custom private label and export packaging based on destination needs
Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and stored under recommended conditions. Store it in a cool, dry, clean place. Protect the package from direct sunlight, high humidity, heat, pests, and strong odors. After opening, reseal the pack tightly and use a clean, dry utensil.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Export Supply

Our minimum order quantity for dehydrated thyme leaves is 5 Kg. That makes a first trial order easy to place. Samples are available on request. Private label and printed packaging projects need extra planning time. Lead time normally depends on stock status and order details. We confirm the expected dispatch date with each quotation. Custom packaging or larger export programs may require additional time. Therefore, we confirm the production schedule before accepting the order. For an accurate quote, share your required quantity, destination country, preferred mesh or cut, packaging size, label requirements, and target application. We can then review the inquiry and provide the dehydrated thyme leaves price, availability, estimated lead time, and shipping information. Sample requests should include the delivery address and intended use.

Quality Standards and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We follow documented food handling, cleaning, moisture control, inspection and batch traceability practices. Our team reviews raw materials and finished goods against the agreed product specification. In addition, packaging carries essential information such as product name, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, and storage instructions. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Buyers can share allergen information needs, labeling rules or import requirements during the quotation stage, and we confirm what can be provided.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals is a manufacturer, wholesale supplier and exporter of food ingredients, based in Surat, India. Our capabilities include dehydration, grinding, blending, sieving, product standardization, and private label packing. As a result, we can support both straightforward bulk orders and broader ingredient programs. We aim to build long-term partnerships through clear communication and consistent specifications. Moreover, our team can help buyers compare packaging formats, optimize order volumes, and plan repeat supply. Contact Tradenest Naturals today to request a sample or quote for dried thyme leaves.
